events.title: Demo Release Very Soon & Discord Server Reveal

events.title: We Pretend New Cinematic/Gameplay Trailer!!!
events.summary: We’re excited to share that a new cinematic and gameplay trailer for We Pretend has been completed. It can be viewed on Kickstarter and on the Steam Page!This trailer gives a closer look at the game’s atmosphere, visual direction, and the type of horror experience we are building.
